title: Spiritual Awakening
subtitle: Test your grasp of Spiritual Awakening — Three Strings, Scare Events, EMF Flash, G.A.A., and the end of the 178,000-year occupation.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Great Spiritual Awakening is not med-beds, debt theater, or party politics. It is the high-velocity uninstallation of a 178,000-year occupation. Sever Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge. Take the flat plain, ice wall, and Firmament as the first step. See Tartaria under the fake timeline. Watch healthcare genocidal compliance without flinching. Wi-Fi opened the pipe; EBS, Bluebeam, and the 30-second Flash close the matrix. Ninety-seven percent NPC density ends. About 520 million genuine souls remain. The Projection Dome dies; bright white dark matter shows. Memory returns in sequence. Soul Families wait beyond the ice wall. Hardwire this so eternity never buys the lie again.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “The Great Spiritual Awakening” refers to the current era defined by the rapid, spoon-fed dissemination of highly suppressed truths regarding planetary occupation, genetic harvesting, and the true shape and nature of the physical realm.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “The Great Spiritual Awakening” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “The Great Spiritual Awakening” as: The current era defined by the rapid, spoon-fed dissemination of highly suppressed truths regarding planetary occupation, genetic harvesting, and the true shape and nature of the physical realm.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “The Great Spiritual Awakening”.

questions.question: What cycle does this period culminate, and what does it expose?

options.label: A
options.text: The end of a 178,000-year cycle of planetary subjugation — systematic exposure of planetary satanism, child sacrifice, and the parasitic occupation.
options.rationale: 178,000-year occupation ends here; satanism, child sacrifice, and parasites are forced into the open.

options.label: B
options.text: Only the invention of Wi-Fi with no connection to history uninstallation or Scare Events.
options.rationale: Wi-Fi aided truth spread; the core is cycle-end exposure and planetary liberation events.

options.label: C
options.text: A ten-year media cycle about sports scores with no link to sacrifice or occupation.
options.rationale: It ends a 178,000-year subjugation cycle and exposes planetary satanism, child sacrifice, and parasitic occupation.

options.label: D
options.text: The start of a new 178,000-year sleep cycle that reinstalls the Amnesia Vortex permanently.
options.rationale: The Amnesia Vortex was dismantled in 2019; this is liberation, not a new sleep cycle.

questions.hint: 178,000-year cycle ends — satanism, sacrifice, parasitic occupation exposed.

questions.question: What are the Three Strings that must be consciously severed?

options.label: A

options.rationale: The Three Strings are Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge — psychological tethers to the matrix.

options.label: B
options.text: Med-beds, debt forgiveness, and geopolitical leadership as the only true liberation path.
options.rationale: Those are named as what the awakening is not; Strings are the real untether work.

options.label: C
options.text: Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge — the primary psychological and societal tethers that bind human cognition to the control matrix.
options.rationale: Three Strings = Religion, Finance, Perceived Knowledge; sever them to unbind cognition.

options.label: D
options.text: Only EBS, Bluebeam, and the EMF Flash as optional entertainment channels.
options.rationale: Those are Scare Event sequence stages; the Strings are Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge.

questions.hint: Religion · Finance · Perceived Knowledge.
